· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (횡보): 뚜렷한 Higher Low 또는 Lower High 패턴 부재 진단

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price($37,230) vs SMA5/20/50($35,280/$35,048/$36,510): mixed signals with short-term SMAs 5/20 above, mid-term SMA 50 below.
· Position vs SMA100($41,475)/SMA200($33,657): mid-to-long term trend above SMA200 but below SMA100, indicating potential for weakening.
· 52-week position (56.7%) + current price level at historical mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (49.3 → 55.5): exiting oversold, now consolidating in neutral territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (442.8874 → 433.9102): slowing improvement, lacking clear trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $35,048): sideways movement around the middle band indicates lack of direction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($34,485): confirmed support zone based on Pivot (PP $35,470) and SMA200($33,657).
· Swing Resistance ($38,775): potential for strengthening uptrend upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (sideways): absence of clear Higher Low or Lower High pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.55x): increased from 5-day average but insufficient to boost trend confirmation confidence.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): digesting recent gains with sideways movement, buy entry conditions not met, maintaining wait-and-see stance.
